RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: Not reliably quantifiable from these facts

An all-male panel is worth noting, but it does not itself establish sex bias. Your longer experience strengthens your case for an explanation, not necessarily entitlement to the role: client relationships, management ability and interview performance may legitimately matter. His announcement may omit qualifications.

Follow up now, requesting the selection criteria, how your application was assessed, and the reasons for the decision. You can also ask how the panel ensured a fair, consistent process, mentioning its composition without alleging discrimination.

Keep correspondence and the advert. If explanations reveal inconsistent standards or gender stereotypes, consider specialist advice. Check local complaint deadlines promptly; waiting for feedback may not extend them.
